profile.summaryJa: 士師記5章15節では、ルベンの水辺に「心の大きな決意」があったと歌われます。続く節も同じ詩的表現を繰り返し、族祖個人ではなく部族の人々を指すと読めます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.
Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.
